releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
The first release of the Freelens extension for CloudNativePG: every PostgreSQL cluster the operator manages, from the Kubernetes resources down to what happens inside the databases right now, inside Freelens.

### What is in it

- **Overview**: every cluster of the selected namespaces as a tile ordered by urgency, with instances, archiving, last and next backup, certificates and the declared objects that failed.
- **Clusters**: the list and the drawer of every cluster (instances, replication, conditions, backups and archiving, certificates), the **Live View** (topology with quorum and lag, sessions, WAL, databases, replication slots, instance managers, trends), the **Logs** of every instance on one time axis, the **Timeline** and the **Failover Quorums**.
- **Backups**: backups, scheduled backups with their next runs, object stores with the recovery windows the Barman Cloud plugin reports; volume snapshot backups.
- **Databases**: declarative databases, roles, publications and subscriptions, with what PostgreSQL does not have as declared.
- **Pooling, Images, Operator**: poolers with their live state, image catalogs, the operator card.
- **Write actions** with a confirmation dialog that lists the exact API calls: backup now, switchover, restart, reload, fencing, hibernation, schedule suspend and resume; **creation forms** for clusters, backups, schedules, poolers and more; **Open psql** on any instance.

### Install

From the Freelens Extensions page, by npm name:

```text
@freelensapp/cnpg-extension
```

Requires Freelens 1.10.3 or newer and CloudNativePG 1.30.0 or newer. See the [README](https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-cnpg-extension#readme) and the [video demo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fa708e56-a775-4bf7-827f-a1a8b461b9a1).
